targets.authors: DiMaggio C, Klein M, Berry C, Frangos S.
targets.title: Black/african american communities are at highest risk of covid-19: spatial modeling of new york city zip code level testing results.
targets.evidence_quote: By replicating DiMaggio et al., we establish whether the same socioeconomic factors are associated with positive COVID-19 tests in New York as in Phoenix.
targets.outcome_quote: For the second replication, we observed directional effects consistent with DiMaggio et al. except in the case of the proportion of residents over 65.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report agreement for several predictors and disagreement for age in the direct replication. Their conceptual replication additionally fails the original primary Black/African American association. The conclusion about that primary association is not an overall verdict covering every tested finding; aggregate comparisons are mixed.

reasoning: Full published seven-page article matches title, DOI and all authors, with complete references. One original paper is independently retested using Phoenix data, with direct and conceptual analyses; citations about methods and other COVID-19 studies are not targets.
